recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as the reconciliation for FHIR-14793. If OO wants a broader current editorial rule against casual "lab" wording outside this bounded ballot comment, it should be raised as a new tracker with explicit scope.
issue_request: FHIR-14793 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request from the 2018-Jan Core ballot asking to change "lab" to "laboratory" in Observation section 10.1.2; it was non-substantive, voted 15-0-2, and applied for STU3.
initial_application: Commit fe6f87024bb28fc7e9742e5d8b8d336423d96c26 explicitly listed #14793 and changed the target Observation Boundaries and Relationships phrase from "from lab, vital sign" to "from laboratory, vital sign" in source/observation/observation-introduction.xml.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, so the inspected introduction source is current build input. Sibling lab-to-laboratory issues FHIR-14794, FHIR-14795, FHIR-14796, and FHIR-14797 are already represented on the combined branch. Remaining current Observation "lab" strings are example URLs/data or later unrelated wording, including FHIR-51529's interpretationContext comment and a 2023 mapping-exception comparison phrase.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope Observation boundary text already says "laboratory, vital sign and other observation types", satisfying the seed issue without duplicating adjacent audits.
